findings.summary: TimeAgo shows an absolute date after 48 h, so the hard-coded ' ago' suffix renders e.g. '13/10/2025 ago' for older revisions. Drop the suffix or render relativeTimeText() instead.

onOpenLogs/onOpenYaml/showToast come from plain App.tsx functions (lines 778, 920, 1172) that are re-created on every App render. That rebuilds usePodLogsHandler, handleEditYaml and handleScale/handleRestart and re-renders the memoized PodDistribution, DeploymentPodsTable and DeploymentHeader. Hold them in latest-refs like onResourceClickRef.

Pure logic in the component folder has no tests: collectConfigRefs (decides which Secret/ConfigMap names are shown), podStatusColor and buildMatrix. Move collectConfigRefs and podStatusColor to src/utils/ and add *.test.ts covering env/envFrom/volume/projected/imagePullSecrets collection and the status colour mapping.

getSortedData(rows) re-sorts on every render, and handleSort from useResourceSorting is never stable, so handleSortClick changes on every render. Use useMemo(() => sortResourceData(rows, sortConfig), [rows, sortConfig]).
